title: Mediterranean Herb Mix
description: A dried herb and spice blend of oregano, basil, dill, rosemary and thyme with onion and garlic granules, for a Mediterranean flavour boost.
steps: Combine all the ingredients together and store in a jam jar or other airtight container. This will keep for up to 6 months.
notes: Use for Lemon Herb Roast Chicken Dinner (p.116) or as a seasoning for any meat, fish or vegetables that need a Mediterranean flavour injection. Calories stated are per tablespoon.
